item.title: Monthly Dharma Group (Saturdays) – Meditation — Thu Dec 3, 10:30 PM
item.description:
Awakening Asheville You do not have to walk this path alone. In fact, this journey is that much more rich and enjoyable when traversed with others. Groups Openings
First Saturday of each month – mornings at 10:30 am Eastern Led by Buddhist teacher Ronya Banks, this group meets once a month, for an hour and a half.
Group Meeting Includes: Group Discussion and Sharing Instruction on Dharma/Buddhist Principles Guided Meditation Meditation Instruction Connecting with Other Practitioners Most people on a spiritual journey find it supportive, often even necessary to get the regular support of a meditation teacher, as well as the mutuality and connection with other meditation practitioners on this path.
This monthly group affords you with the opportunity to connect with a teacher and other like-minded people, wherein you will all boldly delve deeply into different ways of approaching your formal and informal mindfulness practices through the lens of the Buddhist teachings.

item.title: Weekly Critique — Wed Dec 16, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Writers This is the standing weekly critique. Bring anything new you're working on to share with the group. If you don't have a project to share, you are most welcome to attend, discuss, and get inspired.
For our group discussion, please bring at least 8-10 printed copies of your piece. That way, we can all read through each other's work and provide feedback.
Sharing our creative efforts is an important part of the writing process. I'm really looking forward to reading what you've been working on. Don't worry if it's still a rough draft.
If you're having trouble finding us, look for a placard on the table with the group's name.
If you would like to join our group email list for updates regarding contests, events, and more [you can sign up on our website](https://avlwriters.com/).
Source: AVL Writers

item.title: Sunday Sounds | Sean Gaskell — Sun Jan 3, 12:00 PM — Asheville Art Museum
item.description:
Join us for an afternoon of music and art in the Museum. With a soundscape of the West African kora harp, we invite you to experience artwork in the galleries in a more emotional and sensory way. ABOUT THE MUSICIAN Sean Gaskell features songs on the kora- a 21 stringed West African harp. He studied under the extensive instruction of Moriba Kuyateh and the late Malamini Jobarteh in Gambia, and both Youssoupha Cissokho and Mamadou Cissokho in Senegal. The kora is traditionally played by oral historians known as Griots. Many songs featured on the kora preserve an 800-year history dating back to the founding of the Mande empire. Gaskell has presented adult, youth and family programs at over 500 libraries and a multitude of k-12 schools, colleges, universities and assisted living facilities throughout the United States and Canada. For more information, please visit www.seangaskell.com RESERVE TICKETS NOW
Source: Asheville Art Museum

item.title: Manifesting Self — Thu Jan 28, 6:00 PM
item.description:
AVL Digital Nomads **Location Change:** **Disclaimer: In all efforts to keep this Meetup a safe space, we all agree to keep anything said within the group private and confidential.**
Do you want to take your remote working game to the next level? Do you find yourself saying wtf is Manifesting Self??
Well, you’re not alone. Remote working is glamorous, and also presents itself with challenges not seen in the traditional office environment.
Manifesting Self may sound a little out there. Trust me. It’s not. Whether we’ve been in the remote space for years, since the pandemic, or just recently, I’m certain it has changed each of us in ways we never thought possible. Let’s explore that together. The highs, the lows, and everywhere in between. And from there experience growth.
We are so excited to see you, again or for the first time!
Source: AVL Digital Nomads

item.title: World Affairs Council of Western North Carolina: The U.S.-UK Special Relationship — An Insider’s Take — Tue Dec 1, 7:00 PM
item.description: Drawing on her 34 years as an American diplomat, including more than a decade working directly in and on the United Kingdom, Ambassador Barbara Stephenson explores the history and current state of the U.S.-UK Special Relationship. She will discuss the countries’ close cooperation in intelligence, military, and diplomatic affairs, as well as longstanding and emerging points of tension. Through personal anecdotes and photographs from a state visit by the Obamas, Stephenson will offer behind-the-scenes insight into this important bilateral relationship. This event will take place in the Reuter Center and is free and open to the public. About the Speaker Barbara Stephenson is the William and Anne Harrison Vice Provost for Global Affairs and Chief Global Officer at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. A former U.S. ambassador and career Foreign Service officer, she served as U.S. Ambassador to Panama and was the first woman to serve as deputy ambassador and acting ambassador

item.title: QHHT session with Shaman Phil — Thu Dec 3, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Awakening Asheville Explore Your Inner Wisdom: A Personal QHHT Session
Join me for a private, in-person session near Nebo, NC, based on Dolores Cannon’s Quantum Healing Hypnosis Technique (QHHT).
This approximately three-hour session offers an opportunity to explore past-life experiences through guided hypnosis and connect with what this practice calls your Higher Self. Bring your curiosity, questions, and intentions as we explore insights that may support deeper self-understanding and personal reflection.
This appointment is reserved for one person. Sessions take place in my home, where we have friendly cats and a dog. Please let me know beforehand if you have allergies or concerns about animals. For an additional fee, I can also arrange to meet at your home or a mutually agreed-upon location.
To help you prepare, I’ll email you a few simple activities and instructions to complete before our meeting. Please provide your email address when arranging your appointment.
